title: Soybean oil dominates the export mix
detail: Soya-bean oil (excl. crude) and fractions accounted for about 46.5% of Shrawan exports.

title: India dominates Nepal’s export destination mix
detail: India received about 85.9% of Shrawan exports and supplied 54.7% of imports.

title: Birgunj handles about half of imports
detail: Birgunj Customs handled Rs 93.86B of imports in Shrawan.

title: Imports remain far larger than exports
detail: Nepal imported Rs 187.44B against Rs 38.70B of exports in Shrawan.
